agent_discovery.description: Ensure the current Local VIO world epoch has a fresh TRACKING body pose without locating the arm base or resetting the world origin. The operation may start the RGB-D camera and Local VIO and may hold a bounded global motion inhibit while stationary IMU samples are collected.
when_to_use: The operator asks to establish, inspect, or use the current world axes without locating the arm base.
A spatial Skill needs a fresh Local VIO body pose and the current epoch is not yet TRACKING.
Camera and VIO startup alone leaves stationary initialization gated.
when_not_to_use: The operator explicitly asks for a new origin, re-zero, or epoch reset; use reinitialize_space_cognition.
The task requires the world-to-arm-base relationship; use stationary workcell calibration.
The camera rig cannot remain stationary during the bounded initialization interval.
side_effects: May start the configured camera and Local VIO Providers.
May acquire and release a bounded global motion-inhibit lease.
Does not reset the VIO epoch, revoke workcell calibrations, or submit physical motion.
